crossRefs.note: My soul is laid low in the dust. Revive me according to your word!
Behold, I long for your precepts! Revive me in your righteousness.
Consider how I love your precepts. Revive me, Yahweh, according to your loving kindness.
Blessed are those who keep his statutes, who seek him with their whole heart.
I have called to you. Save me! I will obey your statutes.
All the paths of Yahweh are loving kindness and truth to such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.

translations.web: Preserve my life according to your loving kindness, so I will obey the statutes of your mouth.
translations.bsb: Revive me according to Your loving devotion, that I may obey the testimony of Your mouth.
translations.kjv: Quicken me after thy lovingkindness; so shall I keep the testimony of thy mouth.
translations.asv: LAMEDH. Quicken me after thy lovingkindness; So shall I observe the testimony of thy mouth.
